notes.title: Chorus of Carcosa - Movement & Stamina Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

The first weekend for Chorus of Carcosa was huge, and we’ve gathered a ton of valuable feedback.
Thanks to all our players! We’re actively working on the game, and today, we’ve got a big update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45039697/c507964a589ab01eca386287f58ced77c852fb24.jpg[/img]

[b]Today's update focuses on the following issues:[/b]

[list]
[*] Full character movement rebalance: the character now walks and crawls faster, and can run for a longer duration
[*] Stamina and breath indicators are now displayed on the screen. It will disappear when indicators are full to avoid unnecessary clutter
[*] Added more shortcuts in The Winter Garden to make dodging the monster easier
[*] The screen darkening during breath-holding will no longer obstruct visibility
[*] Fixed a fatality bug that occasionally caused the scene to be viewed from the side
[*] Added a prompt about crouching during the first monster encounter
[*] Updated button visuals for skipping the credits
[*] Added some visual hints for star map and musical staff puzzles
[*] And a batch of minor fixes 
[/list]
[i][b]KNOWN ISSUES:[/b][/i] you can encounter a bug - when you die with this stat on the screen, it will break until the next level is loaded. 
We are already working on fixing this bug.

We're carefully reading all the comments about your experience. So if you encounter any bugs or want to share your feedback - feel free to [url=https://discord.com/invite/b7ZjxM5FGb]join our Discord[/url] or write in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2987750/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url].

notes.title: 6 days to go! Here's an FAQ about Chorus of Carcosa release!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45039697/32c8e1bdda192ca16e691efa7c9cebfcc835503f.png[/img]

Hey, all - we've gathered a FAQ post that should help you prepare for Chorus of Carcosa release!

Q: When will Chorus of Carcosa be released?
A: March 20, 10 AM PDT / 6 PM CET.

Q: Will it launch in Early Access?
A: No, the full game will be available at launch!

Q: Which platform will Chorus of Carcosa be available on?
A: Steam.

Q: How much will it cost?
A: $11.99

Q: Do you have plans for a launch discount?
A: Yes, 15%

Q: How long will it take to beat?
A: Around 2-3 hours.

Q: Which languages is Chorus of Carcosa available in?
A: Chorus of Carcosa offers full text support for English, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazilian and Russian.
Audio voice acting is available in English.

Q: Do you have plans for additional languages?
A: Initially, we planned to include a wider range of languages in the game. However, by the time of release, we realized that we wouldn’t be able to provide high-quality translations, so we decided to stick with the languages mentioned above.

Q: Where can I go to discuss the game with others?
A: You're welcome to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/b7ZjxM5FGb]Discord[/url] or [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2987750/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url]! More social media links can be found at the end of the post.

Q: Will it have Steam Workshop support?
A: We've no plans for Steam Workshop.

Q: Will Chorus of Carcosa be released on other platforms in future, any mobile or console versions?
A: We don't have any plans as yet. But additionally you can play Chorus of Carcosa on Steam Deck.

Q: Will there be updates?
A: Yes, we plan to release hotfixes and patches to improve the game over time. However, there are no major content updates planned at the moment.

Phew, the release is just less a week away!

You can also follow us:
🟡[url=https://x.com/ChorusOfCarcosa]X/Twitter[/url]
🟡[url=https://discord.com/invite/b7ZjxM5FGb]Discord[/url]
🟡[url=https://bsky.app/profile/chorus-of-carcosa.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url]
🟡[url=https://www.tiktok.com/@chorusofcarcosa_]TikTok[/url]

Thanks for reading,
Chameleon 42
